Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}

The Gargoyles are not a clan sired in the traditional sense but a servitor bloodline bred by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere}, who transformed captive @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce}, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel}, and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} stock into monstrous, stone-skinned guardian-warriors to protect the young Warlock clan from its enemies. For nearly a thousand years the Gargoyles served their @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} masters in unbreakable thrall, but in recent nights a number have broken free of that control. The bloodline is now split between Slaves, who remain bound to @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} service, and Freemen, who have won their liberty but still choose, out of habit or spite, to remain within the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}. Whether created through the old transformation rite or, increasingly, Embraced outright, a Gargoyle loses nearly all memory of her former life upon joining the bloodline, leaving most to either obsess over their lost identity or embrace their fresh start.

Disciplines: Fortitude, Potence, Visceratika

Advantage: Bred by the Tremere as flying warriors, Gargoyles command Fortitude, Potence and Visceratika and can fly.

Disadvantage: A built-in servility to their makers: all Gargoyles possess the Negative Trait Submissive x2 when attempting to resist Dominate or any other mind-controlling effect.

Organization: Gargoyle society is defined by the divide between Slaves, still bound in deep thrall to Tremere chantries, and Freemen, who wander in search of a place to roost but remain loyal to the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} as a whole. Most player characters are Freemen; a Gargoyle's stoic, patient nature makes her slow to act, but once committed she follows through with speed and decisiveness that belies her stony exterior.
